label: recorded MCP shapes
note: Tool names and input schemas only. No timestamps, balances, or cache documents. A change to committed treasury or balance data does not change this file.

tools.description: Read star systems from the z.ink test realm via @aephia/atlas-kit. Read-only. Inspired by Star Atlas; not an ATMTA service.

limit.description: How many systems to return. Default 100.

tools.name: list_star_systems

tools.description: Read one public fleet by account address, or list fleets owned by a player profile, on the z.ink test realm. Read-only.

profileAddress.description: Player profile address. Lists that profile's fleets when fleetAddress is omitted.

tools.name: get_fleet

tools.description: List keys on a player profile: address, scope, expiry, decoded permissions, and heuristic risk flags. Read-only. Does not use or grant those keys.
tools.name: profile_key_audit

tools.description: Read a public mainnet record for a wallet or a player profile: profiles, creation dates, faction enlistment, SAGE fleets still on the accounts, signature bands, and first and last activity. Read-only. The lookup runs on the server against the public mainnet RPC. Nothing is stored.

address.description: A wallet address or a player profile address.

tools.name: player_legacy

tools.description: Turn a public player_legacy card into a short plain-language story, only after that wallet opts in. The wallet signs a fixed sentence, and an allowlisted hub signer publishes it as a story-optin update. Without a valid unrevoked opt-in the tool returns not opted in and does not tell the story. Read-only. The story does not quote names, prices, or a call to action.

address.description: The wallet that signed the opt-in, or a player profile address that signed one.

tools.name: player_story

tools.description: Live treasury balances, Squads decode, a short proposal list, and data-health checks. A section that cannot be read is an error, not a made-up figure. Read-only.
tools.name: dao_overview

tools.description: Live SOL, ATLAS, and USDC balances for the DAO Treasury and Ecosystem Fund from one getMultipleAccounts read, with the treasury cache as fallback. Includes a read-only Squads v3 decode of the two published multisigs when the live read works. Standard token accounts only. Read-only.
tools.name: treasury_balances

tools.description: Payments and milestones from the public Council Tracker sheet. Blank cells stay null. Read-only.
tools.name: pip_tracker

tools.description: Star systems from the z.ink test realm, with starbases and an activity summary of connections and celestial bodies. Read-only.
tools.name: galaxy_overview

tools.description: The v0 ecosystem category ids. Approved members are unknown until a public roster exists. Read-only.
tools.name: list_categories

tools.description: Read signed hub updates from a public git repo pinned to a commit. The manifest hash is checked first. An update is returned only when its author is allowlisted and it has enough distinct allowlisted approval signatures over that hash. signedBy lists the author and every wallet whose signature verified, including an author who did not count as an approver. approvedBy lists only the wallets whose approvals counted toward the threshold. selfApproved is true when the author key is the only approver. At threshold 2 or higher that approval does not count unless the node allows it. A locally revoked signer does not count, and an update whose only valid approvals are from revoked keys is left out. Revoking a whole signer group is not implemented. A signer-change adds or removes one signer only after the current threshold of other allowlisted signers approve it. An empty allowlist returns nothing. Does not sign or invent updates. Read-only.
tools.name: hub_updates

tools.description: Read signed business listings from the pinned hub store. Filter by stream, category, or status. Expired listings are hidden unless includeExpired is true, and those rows are marked expired. Each listing includes the signer's display name and a plain signedMeaning line. The url is the business's own page. This node does not take payment. Signer, threshold, revocation, and manifest-pin checks match hub_updates. Read-only.

includeExpired.description: When true, include listings whose expiresAt is before today (UTC) and set expired to true.

status.description: available, sold_out, inquire_only, or paused. withdrawn is a takedown and those rows are left out.

tools.name: list_listings

tools.description: Search signed hub listings and guild listings by name, description, and tags, plus the display name of a player who opted in to a public story. A player who has not opted in is left out. The query is text, not an address. Nothing is uploaded. Read-only.

query.description: Text to match. At most 80 characters.

tools.name: search_hub

tools.description: Read claim state for one listing identity, or for every claim in the pinned hub. A player claim is active only when the claimant wallet is a current key on the named player profile. A guild or business claim is active only after curators countersign. The first eligible claim in chain order wins unless curators resolve or revoke it. X and Discord notes are self-attested, unverified, unless a trusted verifier attestation is current. A raw handle is included only when the claim opts in. Read-only. This does not move money.

identity.description: A listing id, a guild name, or an identity key such as id:booth or guild:east-hall. Omit it to list every claim.

tools.name: claim_status

tools.description: H2H bridge feed h2h.c4-markers.v1 (protocol/h2h/SPEC.md section 6.1). One marker per current signed listing and guild listing, with the same signer, threshold, revocation, and manifest-pin checks as hub_updates. Every marker is placement orbit with anchor none: coordinates come only from a signed c4-anchor record, and that kind is not built yet. Also served as GET /c4-markers.json. Not game fleets. Read-only.

anchored.description: true returns only markers with a resolved signed anchor (none exist yet).

kind.description: listing, guild, or all. Default all.

stream.description: Listing stream. Guild markers have no stream and are left out when this is set.

tools.name: list_c4_markers

tools.description: H2H bridge feed h2h.community-tools.v1 (protocol/h2h/SPEC.md section 6.2). A curated list from protocol/h2h/community-tools.json in this node's repo, including the Community developers and Game publisher packages categories in the same feed. Anyone can add a tool with one pull request. Every row is a pointer only. It is not permission, a partnership, an endorsement, or embedding. Each category entry has a credit line naming the public handle. linkOnly means this repo does not copy that kit's code, docs, or assets. A private repo is never listed. Also served as GET /community-tools.json. Read-only.
tools.name: list_community_tools

tools.description: Freshness and the last error for the treasury cache, galaxy proposals, the Council sheet, and wallet balances. Wallet balances say live or cached. Read-only.
tools.name: data_health

tools.description: Live read of the public galaxy proposal list. Returns one page of id, PIP number, status, dates, and the published vote totals. The default page size is 20 and the maximum is 100. Pass nextCursor back as cursor for the next page. Read-only.

cursor.description: Proposal id from the previous page's nextCursor.

tools.name: list_proposals

tools.description: Live read of galaxy /proposals/votes/{id}.json. Summarizes count and voting power per choice. Does not invent a ranked-choice winner. Read-only.

topN.description: How many voters to list, by voting power. Default 0.

tools.name: get_proposal_votes

tools.description: Live read of galaxy /dao/treasury. Monthly revenue by source (segmentation) and mint, with the published USDC value. Read-only.
tools.name: dao_revenue

tools.description: Monthly inflows and outflows for the DAO Treasury and Ecosystem Fund, from the local signature cache. Treasury ATLAS inflows are withheld when the cache cannot support them. Read-only.

allowPartial.description: Include rows the cache cannot fully support. Default false.

wallet.description: dao_treasury, ecosystem_fund, or one of those two published addresses.

tools.name: dao_treasury_flows

tools.description: Payment ledger from the cached signature backfill: signature, time, wallet, token, amount, counterparty, and a Solscan link. Defaults to external outflows. Read-only.

wallet.description: dao_treasury, ecosystem_fund, or one of those two published addresses.

tools.name: dao_payments

tools.description: Balance over time from the same cache as the treasury flows. DAO Treasury ATLAS uses end-of-day snapshots. Other assets replay parsed balances. If the cache file is not in this deployment yet, the result says the cache is not yet populated and includes no figures. Read-only.

wallet.description: dao_treasury, ecosystem_fund, or one of those two published addresses.

tools.name: treasury_history

tools.description: PIP-23 Ecosystem Fund refills, the 5% limit, the next-quarter projection, and remaining ATLAS after caller-supplied unpaid PIPs. Unknown where PIP-23 states no rule. An optional Council override is labelled and does not replace the computed figure. If the cache file is not in this deployment yet, the result says the cache is not yet populated and includes no figures. Read-only.

asOf.description: ISO timestamp used to pick the next quarter date. Defaults to the cached balance time.

councilOverride.description: Labelled Council figure. Shown beside the computed limit, not silently substituted.

unpaidPips.description: Council-supplied unpaid amounts in ATLAS. Omit the field to leave remaining unknown. An empty list means the caller says there are none.

tools.name: ecofund_limit
